story.titleZh: F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛首日：车手合约动态与2027年规则反响
story.summaryZh: 在F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛首日，围场内传出车手合约动态：一份车手合约获得延长，另一份合约看起来即将结束。同时，各方对F1 2027年的两项重大选择作出了反应。
story.originalTitle: F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛首日：车手合约动态与2027年规则反响
story.summaryEn: On the first day of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the F1 paddock saw driver contract developments: one contract was extended while another appears to be ending. Meanwhile, reactions emerged to two major choices for F1 in 2027.
detailZh: 两个故事——一个已经公布，另一个正在发展中——在阿塞拜疆大奖赛前帮助填补了2027年F1车手市场中的几个空缺。
再加上车手们对最近宣布的摩纳哥冲刺赛的反应、一个意外到来的技术升级，以及梅赛德斯和法拉利的引擎罚退更新，这让F1围场里的这个周三出人意料地充满新闻。
以下是我们从这个提前开始的巴库周末到目前为止了解到的情况。
迈凯伦在巴库继续其激进的升级推进，作为将在FP1期间评估的套件的一部分，侧箱经过了大幅修改。
这发生在匈牙利和荷兰大奖赛周末期间引入的重大空气动力学升级之后，这两个周末分别位于八月休赛期两侧，同时也是修订版H翼在蒙扎首次亮相赛道，这个部件在两周前的马德里站被从车上取下后，本周末将重新出现。
侧箱经过重新塑形，向后延伸时呈现出非常不同的向下斜坡形状，这更接近法拉利和梅赛德斯的设计。此外还有一个经过修订、更垂直的进气口形状，类似于奥迪的设计。——Edd Straw
巴库的长直道意味着它是车手接受引擎更换处罚的理想地点，这就是为什么这个选项仍然在法拉利和勒克莱尔的考虑范围内。
但在梅赛德斯那边，制造商及其车手拉塞尔已决定再等一段时间，才将最后一个动力单元加入池中。
正如之前所暗示的那样，Russell 最后一次动力单元更换的时机被安排为与 梅赛德斯 即将在不久后某个时间点引入的 额外开发与升级机会步骤相吻合。10月下旬在 Austin 举行的美国大奖赛将是一个合乎逻辑的举办地点。
从 Russell 的角度来看，现在接受发车位罚退，然后在几场比赛之后当更好的部件到来时又面临另一次罚退，是毫无意义的。
有人猜测 梅赛德斯 的 ADUO 升级将围绕涡轮增压器展开，而 Russell 本人在 Baku 几乎证实了这一点，当时他说他不得不等待，因为在排位赛中发生故障后，他不得不在 Hungary 额外使用了一个涡轮增压器。
“这有点复杂，”他说。“但长话短说，如果我现在拿了一个，我就不得不再拿一个。”—— Jon Noble
...而 Hamilton 的引擎可能已经“赢得了一场比赛”
我们正处于赛季的这个阶段：大多数 F1 车队都在拼命计算，他们的车手在动力单元上剩余的里程是否足以坚持到赛季结束，而无需接受发车位罚退。
对于一些人（例如 Russell）来说，这种命运不可避免，因此关键在于选择最佳时机来执行。
汉密尔顿 在最近几周也处于类似境地，因为看起来如果不进行更换，他将无法坚持到本赛季结束。
但在阿塞拜疆大奖赛之前，汉密尔顿透露，他在西班牙大奖赛早早退赛的阴云中还有一线希望。这次退赛减少了他最新动力单元上的里程数，足以让他现在有可能用现有的装备撑到赛季结束。
“我‘多赚’了一场比赛，所以我认为应该没问题，”他在巴库说道。
然而，他表示，如果法拉利得出结论认为新引擎带来的额外性能超过了任何发车位处罚的负面影响，那么可能会采取战术性决定。
“自然，对于引擎来说，从全新到完成几场比赛后，性能上会有差异，所以我们会在今年晚些时候做出那个决定，”他说。
队友勒克莱尔也是迟早需要一台新引擎的人之一。他正在权衡何时接受罚退最为合适，而他在本周末的巴库就选择这么做也并非不可能。
不过对他来说一个好消息是，他那台最新ADUO 2规格的蒙扎引擎现在已经回到他的引擎池中，可以随时使用。—— JN
据The 比赛的Scott Mitchell-Malm报道，埃斯特班·奥康预计将在年底被哈斯车队放弃，不会获得续约合同——这让他在继续自己已近200场大奖赛的F1生涯方面选择有限。
虽然奥康目前占据的席位尚未正式确定人选，但The 比赛了解到，法拉利F2争冠青训车手拉斐尔·卡马拉处于领先位置——而且奥康看起来甚至连第二选择都不是。
奥康在周三的发言确实像一位知道自己与当前车队没有共同未来的车手，他称自己为“自由身”，并反复回避关于在哈斯继续任职的问题。
而且他显然感到委屈，因为哈斯在两辆赛车于每个比赛周产生一致、相等负载方面的问题有据可查。
“今年我的表现不是问题。每次我拿到有竞争力的赛车时，我都发挥出来了，”他说。——瓦伦丁·霍鲁恩日伊
红牛的新秀无法对哈贾尔的交易提出异议
近年来，在红牛二队中，像Arvid Lindblad这样健康的新秀赛季通常意味着立即晋升到主队——这在很大程度上是因为维斯塔潘一直在摧毁任何与他搭档的队友。
但Lindblad最早也要等到2028年才能获得晋升。尽管他认为哈贾尔在主队的续约“比正常情况稍早了一些”，但他表示自己无法质疑这一决定。
“完全归功于Isack，他可能是过去八年中第一位在红牛作为第二车手表现出色的车手——所以也祝贺他，他获得了提前宣布的安心感，”Lindblad承认道。
“对我自己来说，这并不是我真正考虑的事情；我非常专注于自己，我知道自己正在走的道路和轨迹。我对自己目前的位置非常满意。”
小红牛 队友 劳森 表示，接替 Hadjar 席位的可能性对他来说也从未真正成为一个话题——即使在他最近几场比赛中令人印象深刻地替补出战 红牛 之后也是如此——而且 Hadjar 的新合同“并不令人意外”。- VK
威廉姆斯全年直到现在都超重。至关重要的是，阿尔本 已确认，由于引入两个全新底盘，赛车不仅达到了 768 公斤的最低重量限制，实际上还低于这一标准。
这使威廉姆斯能够携带压舱物，这对于微调重量分配很有用。
“今年到目前为止，我们一直承受着相当大的重量惩罚，”Albon 说。“进入这个周末，我们在车上装了压舱物，所以你可以想象，在很多方面都会有巨大的[性能]提升。重量本身是件大事，而重量是圈速的保证，所以这就是为什么我们知道，无论空气动力学方面表现如何，这都会是很好的一步——但这是一次很好的升级。”
赛季开始时，威廉姆斯FW48被认为超重约28公斤。虽然在随后的比赛中这一重量被逐渐削减，但需要新底盘来实现大部分的减重。
这一点，加上空气动力学升级，预计将给威廉姆斯带来显著的性能提升。本赛季威廉姆斯平均是第九快的赛车，但最近已滑落至第十，落后于有所改进的阿斯顿·马丁-本田。
然而，正如阿尔本所指出的，这是一次“在任何其他年份都会是巨大”的升级，但鉴于整个围场的整体发展速度，它相对而言并不像通常那样是一次巨大的跨越。
尽管如此，他表示“这肯定能让我们重新回到与那个集团竞争的行列”——即使队友卡洛斯·塞恩斯给出了悲观的评价：“即使有所有这些升级，我们仍然会难以冲出Q1，也难以跻身Q2前列。”
detailEn: Two stories - one that's been announced, and another that's developing - have helped fill in a couple more gaps in the 2027 Formula 1 driver market ahead of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

Throw in drivers' reactions to the recently announced Monaco sprint race, the arrival of an unexpected tech upgrade, and engine-penalty updates at Mercedes and Ferrari, and it's been a surprisingly newsworthy Wednesday in the F1 paddock.
Here's what we've learned so far from this early-starting Baku weekend.
McLaren is continuing its aggressive upgrade push in Baku, with dramatically revised sidepods as part of the package it will evaluate during FP1.

This follows the major aerodynamic upgrade introduced across the Hungarian and Dutch GP weekends either side of the August break and the first on-track appearance of the revised H-wing at Monza, a part that will reappear this weekend having been taken off the car for the Madring two weeks ago.

The sidepods have been reshaped to have a very different downward ramp shape as they travel rearwards, which is closer to the Ferrari and Mercedes designs. There's also a revised, more vertical inlet shape similar to the Audi design. - Edd Straw
Baku's long straights mean it is an attractive place for drivers to take engine change penalties, which is why that option remains on the radar for Ferrari and Charles Leclerc.
But over at Mercedes, the manufacturer and its driver George Russell have committed to waiting a bit longer to add the final power unit to the pool.

As has been hinted at before, the timing of Russell's final power unit change is planned to coincide with an ADUO (Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities) step that Mercedes will introduce at some point soon. The United States GP at Austin in late-October would be a logical place for it.
From Russell's perspective, there is no point taking a grid drop now only to then face another one a few races down the road when the better parts come along.

There has been speculation that the Mercedes ADUO upgrade will revolve around the turbo, something that Russell himself all but confirmed in Baku when he said he was having to wait because he had to take an extra one in Hungary after a failure in qualifying.
"It's all a bit complicated," he said. "But long story short, if I took one now, I would have had to have taken another one." - Jon Noble
...and Hamilton's engine might've 'gained a race'

We are at that stage of the season where most F1 teams are furiously trying to work out if their drivers have enough miles left in their power units to get to the end without the need for a grid drop penalty.
For some (such as Russell) that fate is unavoidable, so it is a matter of picking the best time to do it.
Lewis Hamilton had been in a similar situation over recent weeks as it looked like he would not make it through to the end of the campaign without a swap.

But ahead of the Azerbaijan GP, Hamilton revealed that there was a silver lining to the cloud of his early Spanish GP retirement. The DNF reduced the mileage on his latest power unit enough to make it possible to now get through to the end of the campaign with what he has.
"I 'gained' a race, so I think it should be OK," he said in Baku.
However, he has suggested that a tactical call could come into play if Ferrari concludes that the extra performance a fresh engine gives outweighs the downside of any grid drop.
"Naturally with engines, from new to when they've done several races, there is a difference in performance, so we will take that decision later on in the year," he said.
Team-mate Leclerc is one of those who will need a fresh one at some point. He is weighing up when best to take a penalty, and it's not impossible he elects to do so in Baku this weekend.
One good bit of news for him, though, is that his Monza engine, of the latest ADUO 2 spec, is now back in his pool and available to be used. - JN

As reported by The Race's Scott Mitchell-Malm, Esteban Ocon is now expected to be let go by Haas at the end of the year without a renewal offer - leaving him with limited options to continue an F1 career that has already spanned nearly 200 starts.

While the seat Ocon currently occupies has not been filled officially, The Race understands Ferrari's Formula 2 title-contending junior Rafael Camara is in pole position - and it doesn't appear like Ocon is even second choice.

Ocon certainly spoke on Wednesday like a driver who knows there is no joint future with his current team, describing himself as a "free agent" and repeatedly deflecting questions about a continued employment at Haas.
And he clearly feels hard done by, given Haas's well-documented issues in the matter of its two cars producing consistent, equal load weekend to weekend.
"My performance hasn't been an issue this year. I've performed every time I had the [performing] car," he said. - Valentin Khorounzhiy
Red Bull's rookie can't argue with Hadjar deal

In recent years, a rookie season as healthy as the one Arvid Lindblad has enjoyed in Red Bull's second team has usually meant an immediate graduation to the main team - in large part because Max Verstappen has been demolishing anyone matching up against him as a team-mate.

But Lindblad will have to wait until 2028 at the earliest to get a promotion. And while he reckons Isack Hadjar's extension at the main team came "a little bit earlier than normal", he says he can't question the decision.

"Full credit to Isack, he's probably been one of the first drivers in the last eight years that has been performing well as the second driver in Red Bull - so also fair play to him that he gets that comfort of getting announced a bit earlier," Lindblad acknowledged.
"For myself, it wasn't really something I was thinking about; I'm very focused on myself, I know my own path and trajectory that I'm on. I'm very happy where I am at the moment."

Racing Bulls team-mate Liam Lawson indicated that the prospect of taking Hadjar's seat was also never really a topic for him - even after his impressive stand-in stint at Red Bull in recent races - and that the new Hadjar deal is "not surprising". - VK

Williams has been overweight all year, up to now. Crucially, Alex Albon has confirmed that not only is the car on the minimum weight limit of 768kg thanks to the introduction of two brand-new chassis, but it is in reality below that.
This allows Williams to carry ballast, which is useful for fine-tuning the weight distribution.

"We've been carrying a substantial weight penalty this year so far," said Albon. "Going into this weekend, we've got ballast on the car, so you could imagine there's a big [performance] swing in many ways. The weight itself is a big thing and weight is a guarantee of laptime, so that's why we know it will be a good step regardless of how the aero side performs - but it's a good upgrade."

At the start of the season, the Williams FW48 was understood to be around 28kg over the weight limit. While that was whittled away at in the ensuing races, it required the new chassis to achieve the majority of the weight reduction.

That, combined with the aerodynamic upgrades, is expected to give a significant performance bump to the Williams, which has been the ninth-fastest car on average this season but lately slipped to 10th behind the improved Aston Martin-Honda.

However, as Albon has pointed out, this is an upgrade that "in any other year would have been a massive one" but that isn't as big a relative stride as it normally would be given the overall rate of development across the grid.

Nonetheless, he says "it's certainly going to get us back in contention with that group" - even if team-mate Carlos Sainz offered the downbeat verdict that "even with all the upgrades, we're still going to struggle to get out of Q1 and we're going to struggle to be at the top end of Q2".

relatedItems.titleZh: 巴库小红牛队友相撞未被处罚 劳森表示不解
relatedItems.summaryZh: 阿塞拜疆大奖赛中，小红牛车队的林德布拉德锁死刹车撞上队友劳森，导致后者赛车底板破损退赛，但干事在事发20分钟内判定无需进一步行动。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Shock inaction over Baku's other F1 team-mate clash explained
relatedItems.summaryEn: At the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, Racing Bulls' Arvid Lindblad locked up and crashed into team-mate Liam Lawson, destroying Lawson's floor and race, yet the stewards dismissed the incident as requiring no further action within 20 minutes.
detailZh: 小红牛车队内部在F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛上发生的碰撞导致利亚姆·劳森退赛，令人意外的是，这次事故被裁定无需进一步处理。
弗兰科·科拉平托因撞上他的阿尔卑斯车队队友皮埃尔·加斯利以及兰多·诺里斯的迈凯伦，被处以10秒时间罚时（转换为马来西亚大奖赛退后五个发车位），但干事们决定不对发生在他们身后的那次碰撞采取行动。
当奥康和劳森在一号弯刹车区并排行驶时，林德布拉德最终锁死了刹车，撞上了姐妹车的劳森，在后者赛车底盘上撞出了一个大洞，毁掉了劳森的比赛。
事故发生后不到20分钟，该事件就已被记录、列入调查，随后又被裁定无需进一步处理。
当被《The Race》问及这一判罚时，劳森说：“对车队来说是好事（林德布拉德最终获得第七名），是的，显然我不会去抗议我的队友——但我不理解这个判罚，因为我被撞得非常重，我的底板都被撞出一个洞了。
“我当时正在转向入弯，给对方留出了空间。所以从我的角度来看，我不理解这个判罚，但可以说这对车队来说是好事。”
林德布拉德为这次碰撞向小红牛和劳森道歉，但也为这次事故提出了两个可以减轻责任的情况。
“那完全是一片混乱。我想就像你们在巴库几乎所有的安全车重启时看到的那样，一号弯会变得相当混乱，我不知道前方发生了什么，但管理得相当糟糕，车流没有聚拢在一起，”林德布拉德说。
“从我们所处的位置来看，我和埃斯特班，还有奥利（比尔曼），在直道上已经来回了大概三次；我们一遍遍地减速又重新出发。所以当时完全是一片混乱，赛车的电池也因此不在理想的工作窗口内。”
“每个人在一号弯都刹车刹得有点太晚，我本来准备对埃斯特班完成超越，但他在最后一刻变线——基本上就是在刹车时变线，所以我不得不采取避让动作，这意味着我的前轮稍微锁死，然后撞上了利亚姆。”
“所以很明显，我已经向他道歉了；我也向车队道歉了，因为这种事情不是你想要的，今天我们本来可能有两个车手进入积分区，但与此同时我们也接受了这个结果。”
林德布拉德是在刚刚完成比赛、还没有太多时间复盘这次事故的情况下说这番话的，但他表示，在安全车重启时处于车流中间的感觉“糟透了”。
“这次重启做得并不好。到最后应该是整个车队慢慢聚拢，然后大家同时出发，”林德布拉德说。
“所以我确信下周的车手简报会上会有人提出这个问题，我们也需要讨论一下，但说实话，两次重启都不太好。
“你得往前看几辆车，搞清楚发生了什么，但在这里我们要应对的事情实在太多了。到最后，那是一条两公里长的直道，轮胎是冷的，刹车是冷的，电池显然又是一个新问题。当大家不停地在走和停之间切换时，是相当危险的，我认为我们需要弄清楚原因。”
他的第一个可以减轻责任的因素——轮胎和刹车冰冷情况下艰难的重启——确实是相关的，但这是否应该让他免于任何处罚则非常值得怀疑。毕竟，对于受到处罚的科拉平托来说，这些因素同样存在。
至于奥康在刹车时移动的说法，实际情况似乎并非如此，奥康一直保持在劳森左侧的线路上。如果非要说的话，反倒是右侧的劳森横向移动，试图封堵奥康的线路。
林德布拉德给出了一个即兴的现场观点，不应该因此受到苛责，但令人费解的是，对于一起看起来证据确凿的事故——一名失控的车手因误判而猛烈撞上另一辆车——干事们为何会如此迅速地排除任何处罚。
干事们之所以基本没有处罚林德布拉德，是因为他们认为这起事故是前方科拉平托、加斯利和诺里斯相撞事故的直接后果。
“这起事故，加上科拉平托锁死刹车，引发了林德布拉德前方紧随的几辆车做出紧急刹车反应，”干事的裁决中写道。
“与此同时，林德布拉德的位置被左右两侧的赛车夹在中间。过弯时，林德布拉德与劳森发生了碰撞。
“在查看了涉事赛车的位置和移动情况后，干事们认定，这次碰撞主要是由于林德布拉德可用的空间受限，以及前方事故引发的连锁反应所致，而不是林德布拉德的任何行为或失误导致，因此不能认定他负有全部或主要责任。
当你回看事故画面时，这个解释对林德布拉德来说显得非常宽厚。加斯利、科拉平托和诺里斯的撞车发生在相当远的前方，在林德布拉德撞上劳森之前，奥孔和劳森似乎都没有做出任何有意义的躲避动作。
干事的报告对此只字未提——但也可能存在一条不成文的规则，即干事对队友之间碰撞的判罚，不如对不同车队车手之间的碰撞那样严厉。正如劳森自己所说：“我不会去抗议我的队友。”
如果干事们选择在赛后进行调查，小红牛显然会请求不予处罚。
但在评判这类事件时，赛车的颜色不应成为考量因素。
detailEn: The intra-team Racing Bulls collision at Formula 1’s Azerbaijan Grand Prix that wiped out Liam Lawson was surprisingly dismissed as needing no further action.

Franco Colapinto was handed a 10-second time penalty (converted into a five-place grid drop for the Malaysian Grand Prix) for spearing into his Alpine team-mate Pierre Gasly and Lando Norris’s McLaren, but the stewards decided not to act on the collision that took place behind them.

While Ocon and Lawson were side-by-side in the Turn 1 braking zone, Lindblad ended up locking his brakes and running into Lawson in the sister car, punching a big hole in its floor and ruining Lawson’s race.
Within 20 minutes of the incident occurring, the incident had been noted, placed under investigation and then dismissed as needing no further action.

Asked about the ruling by The Race, Lawson said: “Great for the team [Lindblad went on to finish seventh], yeah, obviously I'm not going to go and protest my team-mate - but I don't understand it because I got hit so hard that it put a hole in my floor.
“I was just turning for the corner, giving the guy space. So where I'm sitting, I don't understand, but let's say it's great for the team.”
Lindblad apologised to Racing Bulls and Lawson for the clash but offered two mitigating circumstances for the incident.

“It was an absolute mess. I think as you see on almost all safety car restarts here in Baku it gets quite chaotic in Turn 1, I don't know what was happening at the front, but it was pretty poorly managed in the sense that the field wasn't bunched up,” Lindblad said.

“From where we were, me and Esteban, we'd gone - or Ollie [Bearman] - about three times on the straight; we'd sort of gone and braked and gone again. So it was complete chaos, the battery wasn't in a good window because of that.

“Everyone braked a little bit too late in Turn 1 and I was going to make the move on Esteban and he moved in the last minute - basically moved under braking, so [I] had to take avoiding action, which meant I locked the front slightly and I hit Liam.

“So obviously I've apologised to him already; I've apologised to the team because it's not something you want, because there could have been two of us in the points today, but also at the same time we take the result.”
Lindblad was speaking fresh from finishing the race with limited time to review the incident, but he says it was “terrible” in the middle of the train at the safety car restart.
“It wasn't a well-done restart. In the end it should be a bunched-up field that goes slowly, and then we all go at once,” Lindblad said.
“So I'm sure it will get raised at the briefing next week, and it's something we'll discuss, but honestly both restarts weren't very good.

“You're trying to look a few cars ahead to see what's going on, but there are so many things we're having to manage here. In the end, it's a 2km straight, tyres are cold, brakes are cold, batteries are obviously a new problem. When everyone's going-and-stopping it's pretty dangerous and I think we need to understand why.”

His first mitigating factor, a tricky restart on cold tyres and brakes, is certainly relevant, but whether that should absolve him of any penalty is highly questionable. Those were also factors applicable for the penalised Colapinto, after all.

As for Ocon moving under braking, this really doesn’t appear to be the case, with Ocon holding his line to the left of Lawson. If anything, it’s Lawson on the right who makes a move across to try to cover Ocon.

Lindblad shouldn’t be judged harshly for giving a fresh-from-the-moment opinion, but what’s baffling is why the stewards elected to quickly rule out any punishment for what appeared to be a clear-cut case of one out-of-control driver slamming into another with a misjudged move.
The stewards predominantly didn’t punish Lindblad because they believed the incident to be a direct consequence of the Colapinto/Gasly/Norris shunt ahead.
“That incident, together with Colapinto locking his brakes, triggered a braking reaction among the cars immediately ahead of Lindblad,” the stewards’ decision read.
“At the same time, Lindblad was positioned between cars on either side. During the corner, Lindblad made contact with Lawson.

“Having reviewed the positioning and movement of the cars involved, the stewards determined that the contact was primarily the result of the restricted space available to Lindblad and the chain reaction caused by the incident ahead, rather than any action or error for which Lindblad could be considered wholly or predominantly to blame.”

When you review the incident footage, that explanation feels incredibly generous to Lindblad. The Gasly/Colapinto/Norris crash happened far enough up the road that Ocon and Lawson didn’t appear to initiate any meaningful avoiding action before Lindblad went into Lawson.

The stewards' report makes no reference to it - but there could also be the unwritten rule of the stewards not judging team-mate collisions as harshly as collisions involving drivers from different teams. As Lawson himself said: “I'm not going to go and protest my team-mate.”
Had the stewards opted for a post-race investigation, Racing Bulls would have obviously requested no penalty.
But what colour the cars are shouldn’t be a factor when judging these incidents.
keyPointsZh: 科拉平托因撞上队友加斯利和诺里斯的迈凯伦被罚10秒，折算为马来西亚大奖赛退后五位发车
劳森表示不会抗议自己的队友，但不理解这一裁决
林德布拉德向车队和劳森道歉，并解释巴库安全车重启时一号弯通常非常混乱
keyPointsEn: Franco Colapinto received a 10-second penalty converted into a five-place grid drop in Malaysia for hitting team-mate Pierre Gasly and Lando Norris's McLaren
Lawson said he would not protest his own team-mate but does not understand the ruling
Lindblad apologised but noted that Turn 1 is chaotic on almost every safety car restart in Baku

relatedItems.titleZh: 科拉平托引发多车相撞 阿尔派考虑后续处理
relatedItems.summaryZh: 弗朗哥·科拉平托在阿塞拜疆大奖赛安全车重启后的第一弯锁死刹车，导致自己、队友加斯利和诺里斯三车相撞，阿尔卑斯表示将研究应采取何种行动。赛后计时系统判定对其处以10秒罚时，因其未完赛而转换为下站罚退，干事宣布为罚退五位。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Alpine to consider what action to take after Colapinto crash
relatedItems.summaryEn: Franco Colapinto locked up into the first corner at a safety car restart in the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, taking out himself, team-mate Pierre Gasly and Lando Norris, and Alpine says it will consider what action to take. A 10-second post-race penalty was converted into a five-place grid drop for the next race since he did not finish.
detailZh: 阿尔派 车队将“考虑应采取何种行动”，来处理其车手弗朗哥·科拉平托在一级方程式阿塞拜疆大奖赛中引发的“非常糟糕的操作”所导致的多车相撞事故。
世界冠军兰多·诺里斯表示，科拉平托应该被禁赛一场。这位 阿尔派 车手在安全车结束后重新起步时，进入第一弯刹车抱死，导致自己、队友皮埃尔·加斯利以及诺里斯全部出局。
科拉平托称这是一次“重大失误”，并表示他一踩下刹车就发生了抱死，当时已经“失控”。
比赛结束后，一级方程式的计时系统报告科拉平托因引发碰撞被处以 10 秒处罚；由于他没有完赛，该处罚将转化为下一场比赛的发车顺位退后。
干事已宣布，这将是一次退后五位发车的处罚。
阿尔派（阿尔派）执行顾问弗拉维奥·布里亚托利说：“我想花时间反思这件事，并考虑应该采取什么行动，这样我们才能从中吸取教训，避免将来再出现这种情况。”
布里亚托利表示，阿尔派（阿尔派）就“毁了他们的比赛”向诺里斯和迈凯伦道歉，科拉平托本人此前也已经这么做了。
“我知道弗兰科已经承担了全部责任，这是他应该做的；事实上，考虑到比赛当时的局势和安全车重启的情况，他刹车得太晚了，”布里亚托利说。
“对于一位拥有他这种经验的车手来说，这是一次非常糟糕的举动。”
目前尚不清楚阿尔派愿意对科拉平托采取什么行动，比如让他停赛一场比赛，还是仅仅在队内进行警告。
不过，据了解，布里亚托雷对这次失误非常不满，因为它影响了阿尔派的年度冠军争夺战。
科拉平托和加斯利原本在比赛中将为阿尔派实现双车得分，至少获得第九和第十名，这将使阿尔派在车队积分榜上与小红牛的差距缩小到仅六分。
相反，这次事故让 小红牛 意外收获积分，因为混乱为阿尔维德·林德布拉德清出了道路——他在同一次重启时撞上了自己的队友利亚姆·劳森，但未被处罚——最终获得第七名。
这意味着阿尔派目前在争夺第五名的较量中落后 小红牛 15 分。
布里亚托雷说：“显然，我对今天比赛的结果极其失望，要知道我们在争夺积分榜的战斗中损失了宝贵的积分。”
“这类事故不应该发生，尤其是当时我们两辆赛车都跑在积分区内、形势很好的时候。”
"我为车队感到非常难过，也为皮埃尔感到难过，他整个周末都做得非常出色。"
诺里斯是唯一一个认为应该受到全面禁赛处罚的人。
锁定车轮后他成了“乘客”（完全无法控制赛车），其他车手对此表示同情，前三名完赛者——乔治·拉塞尔、马克斯·维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈贾尔——都认为禁赛过于严厉。
"这是一个小错误却造成了严重后果，"拉塞尔说。"我个人认为，禁赛处罚应该只针对那些故意做出非常危险、非常鲁莽行为的车手。"
哈贾尔实际上表示，这条赛道“不够好”，因为偏离行车线的地方颠簸不平，而且在安全车后面难以让轮胎达到工作温度。
一次事故撞毁两辆赛车，以及随之而来的禁赛呼声，让人联想到2012年比利时大奖赛发车时由罗曼·格罗斯让引发的多车相撞事故，他当时因此被禁赛一场。
但科拉平托的这次撞车有两个关键区别：一是涉及赛车数量更少，二是格罗斯让的禁赛正是正式驾照扣分制度出台的契机，该制度现在会在12个月的时间跨度内累计统计驾驶违规行为。
因此，目前已经有一套机制来处罚屡犯者。正因如此，单方面对科拉平托实施禁赛充其量只会显得过于严苛，因为如果他确实屡次犯规，只要这套制度被正确执行，自然会对他进行处理。
面对布里托雷这样严厉的老板的怒火，同时还要为车队在争冠路上痛失一个重要成绩而懊悔，这本身也是一种不好受的惩罚。
detailEn: Alpine will "consider what course of action should be taken" against its driver Franco Colapinto for the "very poor move" that caused a multi-car crash in Formula 1's Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

World champion Lando Norris said Colapinto deserved a race ban after the Alpine driver locked up into the first corner at a restart following a safety car period, and wiped out himself, team-mate Pierre Gasly and Norris too.
Colapinto described it as a "big mistake" and said he was "out of control" after locking up as soon as he jumped on the brakes.

F1's timing system reported a 10-second penalty for Colapinto after the race had finished for causing a collision, which gets converted into a grid drop for the next race instead as he did not finish.
The stewards has announced that this will be a five-place drop.
Alpine executive advisor Flavio Briatore said: "I want to take time to reflect on it and consider what course of action should be taken, so we can learn from it and avoid such a situation in future."
Briatore said Alpine apologises to Norris and McLaren "for ruining their race", which Colapinto had already done himself too.
"I know that Franco has taken full responsibility for it, as he should; in fact he braked far too late considering the context of the race and the safety car restart," said Briatore.
"It was a very poor move for a driver of his experience."
It is not clear what action Alpine would be willing to take against Colapinto, like benching him for a race itself, or whether it would limit it simply to a warning internally.
However, Briatore is understood to be very unhappy with the error, given the impact it has on Alpine's championship fight.

Colapinto and Gasly were on course for a double-points finish for Alpine in the race, at least ninth and 10th, which would have cut the gap to Racing Bulls to just six points in the constructors' championship.

Instead the incident allowed Racing Bulls to land an unexpected points haul as the chaos cleared a path for Arvid Lindblad - who drove into his own team-mate Liam Lawson at the same restart but avoided a penalty - to finish seventh.
This means Alpine now trails Racing Bulls by 15 points in the fight for fifth.
"Obviously I'm extremely disappointed with the outcome of today's race, knowing we lost valuable points in the championship fight," said Briatore.
"These sort of incidents shouldn't happen, particularly when we were running well with both cars in point-scoring positions.
"I feel very sorry for the team and for Pierre who did a great job all weekend."
Norris stands alone in believing a full-on suspension is merited.
He was a passenger after locking up and other drivers had sympathy for this, with the top-three finishers - George Russell, Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar - all agreeing a ban would be too harsh.
"It was a small error that had a big consequence," said Russell. "I think, personally, race bans should come from drivers intentionally doing something very dangerous and very reckless.
Hadjar actually said the track is "not good enough" because it is bumpy off-line and hard to generate tyre temperature behind the safety car.
Wiping out two cars, and the call for a ban, conjures images of the 2012 Belgian GP start shunt caused by Romain Grosjean, which he got a one-race ban for.

But there are two key differences in Colapinto's crash: it involved a smaller number of cars, and Grosjean's ban was the trigger for a formal licence penalty point system that now tots up driving offences over a 12-month period.

So, there is a structure in place to punish repeat offenders. Which is why unilaterally banning Colapinto would be heavy-handed at best as the system will take care of that if he proves a repeat offender and it is applied correctly.
Facing the wrath of a stern operator such as Briatore, mourning the loss of an important result in the team's championship fight, is also an unenviable punishment in itself.
keyPointsZh: 世界冠军争夺者诺里斯表示科拉平托应该被禁赛一场。
科拉平托称这是一次重大失误，表示一踩刹车就失去了控制。
布里亚托利就毁掉诺里斯和迈凯伦的比赛向其道歉，并称以科拉平托的经验而言，这是一个非常糟糕的操作。
keyPointsEn: Lando Norris said Colapinto deserved a race ban for the incident.
Colapinto called it a big mistake and said he was out of control as soon as he jumped on the brakes.
Flavio Briatore apologised to Norris and McLaren for ruining their race and said it was a very poor move for a driver of his experience.

relatedItems.titleZh: 2026年F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛的赢家与输家
relatedItems.summaryZh: 2026年F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛充满戏剧性：队友相撞、世界冠军呼吁禁赛某车手、车手胜利荒终结、顶尖车队复苏以及回归车手登上领奖台。本文分析了谁表现最好、谁表现最差。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Winners and losers from F1's 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix
relatedItems.summaryEn: The 2026 Formula 1 Azerbaijan Grand Prix featured team-mates colliding, the world champion calling for a driver to be banned, a win drought broken, a top team resurgent and a returnee on the podium. This piece analyses who came out best and worst.
detailZh: 队友相撞、世界冠军呼吁禁止一名车手参赛、连胜荒被打破、一支顶级车队强势复苏、还有一位回归车手登上领奖台——2026年F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛上可谓精彩纷呈。
以下是我们对谁表现最好、谁表现最差的看法。
在蒙扎展现出一些令人鼓舞的迹象之后——弗朗哥·科拉平托在那里速度很快但出现了失误——又在马德里赛道上比阿尔派队友皮埃尔·加斯利更快，并且可以说交出了他进入F1以来最好的一个比赛周末——结果他却干了蠢事，把这一切都毁了。
有几位车手公开为他辩护。卡洛斯·塞恩斯指出了巴库赛道棘手的轮胎状况、脏污的赛道以及发动机怪异的动力输出，而阿尔维德·林德布拉德则批评了安全车重启的处理方式。
但最终，科拉平托是唯一一个把两个前轮都锁死、并同时撞上两辆车的人。当其中一辆车是你队友的车时，你就真的麻烦了。他至少承担了“全部责任”——尽管在这种情况下他其实也没有别的选择。
由于他无法接受赛事干事判给他的10秒时间处罚，这将意味着他在雪邦要接受发车位置处罚。— 本·安德森
从几乎稳拿双车积分，到因为科拉平托一次重大的刹车误判，最终酿成双车退赛的灾难性结果，前后不过一瞬。
对于阿尔派（阿尔派）来说，这最终是本周末的一个灾难性结局，此前他们刚打造出加斯利所称的“我们今年目前为止最好的赛车”。
科拉平托把加斯利和诺里斯的迈凯伦一起撞出比赛，这不仅让阿尔卑斯至少损失了他们在事故发生前所持有的七个积分，还间接造就了林德布拉德接手加斯利原来的第七名的机会，使小红牛在车队年度总冠军争夺战中与阿尔卑斯争夺第五名的差距扩大到15分。—— BA
2024年4月21日。要追溯到这个日期，才能找到红牛上一次双车登上领奖台的记录，那就是维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈贾尔在巴库以第二、三名完赛的这次。对于一个尽管遭遇种种困境、却显然始终是F1顶尖强队之一的车队来说，这个数据简直是荒谬的。
这是哈贾尔升入红牛一队以来我们见过的最佳表现之一——他本人也承认，这是他“第一次在这个车队真正度过一个非常干净的周末”——考虑到这是他伤愈复出后的第一个比赛周末，这就更加令人印象深刻了。
他在缠斗中十分高效，在维斯塔潘逼近时清楚地理解了任务，并且像职业选手一样执行了车队战术。甚至连他的无线电通话听起来都比平时缓和了一些。
如果他是想向红牛展示自己缺阵期间车队错过了什么，这可真是一个再好不过的方式了。——杰克·科曾斯
这个周六，1号弯对迈凯伦来说简直像是恶意针对：两次冲出赛道加上一次撞车，导致车队在本该轻松击败动力受限的法拉利、拿到积分的周末颗粒无收。
诺里斯整个周末都显得不顺（受某个问题限制速度，而且明显状态也不佳），所以在同一弯角他自己已经因冲出赛道搞砸了比赛之后不久，又与阿尔派撞车，这简直是为一场糟糕透顶的比赛画上最后一个屈辱的句号。
他对科拉平托的失误毫不留情地进行了评价，但同时也对自己的比赛感到不满。
"以我当时拥有的速度，我在场上毫无机会，"他哀叹道。"当然，在驾驶方面确实有一些我做得不够好的地方，我需要看看下次能改进什么，但同时，他们超越我时展现出的速度，那是根本不可能追上的。所以这基本上是一项在场上不可能完成的任务。"
但队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在争夺领奖台的战斗中表现出色，直到一次奇怪的双前轮锁死让他名次大幅下滑。
"我不觉得我做了什么特别的事导致锁死，"他思索道。"显然我当时走的路线和平时不同，因为我在防守，所以不知道是不是正好压到了路面的隆起或什么东西，但这对我来说确实很意外。" —— 瓦尔·霍罗恩日
乔治·拉塞尔从杆位出发赢得胜利，他形容这是"我职业生涯中最具统治力的一个周末"，这印证了他自八月休赛期以来反复提及的进步。
毕竟，虽然排位赛中争冠对手安东内利在一号弯撞墙，等于给了拉塞尔一次畅通无阻的机会，但拉塞尔本身速度确实很快，而且看起来他对自己的梅赛德斯队友本来就有速度优势。
拉塞尔说："我为今年艰难时期自己和身边的工程师团队所展现出的韧性感到非常自豪，因为为了克服一些挑战、让我的驾驶风格更好地适应这辆新车，我们付出了大量的努力。F1竞争如此激烈，你没有机会去练习这些。
"而且现在，这些驾驶感觉比以前更直觉化了，我的信心也在增强。尤其是在这样的赛道上，它能让你在刹车时多榨出那么一点点，让赛车离墙更近一点，这是一个完美的周末。" —— 埃德·斯特劳
正赛最快圈速通常是用来看比赛表现的糟糕指标，但博塔斯的最快圈速比凯迪拉克队友佩雷兹慢了1.5秒，这确实反映出了我们所看到的这场比赛的差距。
甚至在比赛末段那次撞车之前——那次事故被归因于更早在1号弯冲出赛道触发了能量回收系统故障，“系统有点混乱”——他的表现就已经糟糕得让人摸不着头脑。
“这是一场漫长的比赛，”博塔斯坦承。“说实话，完全没有速度。我只能和费尔南多（阿隆索）竞争。我们在那里确实损失了一些时间，但除此之外也差得很远，所以这个周末有很多东西需要研究。”
“差得很远”还是说得轻了——博塔斯第一次进维修区时已经落后佩雷斯将近一分钟，所以不管问题是什么，都相当严重——这必须是他自己和凯迪拉克要优先解决的头等大事。——VK
就速度而言，这是维斯塔潘和红牛最强的一个周末，尽管动力单元处于劣势，他最终只落后冠军拉塞尔0.2秒，这证明了红牛正在取得的进步。
尽管如果他本应从前排发车，而不是因为动力单元问题从第八位发车，他的夺冠机会可能会更大，但维斯塔潘怀疑，无论如何他也很难做得比第二名更好。
"即使我从第二位发车，我认为乔治的节奏也会很难被超越，"维斯塔潘说。
但红牛在阿塞拜疆是真正的冠军争夺者（这在2026年很罕见），而且从本应发车的位置起步可能带来胜利的可能性令人心动，这对维斯塔潘来说是一个急需的提振。—— ES
在卡洛斯·塞恩斯最初排位第九后被罚退五位之后，亚历克斯·阿尔本获得了向队友复仇的机会，因为他在第二节排位赛被淘汰了。
他在3号弯撞车前一直守在第13位，把奥康压在身后，当时他刹车锁死，径直撞上护墙。塞恩斯则在早段进站掉到第19位后强势回归，最终拿回一个积分。
阿尔本称这次事故很“奇怪”。他认为可能是阵风加上威廉姆斯赛车在重刹时会抬起一个车轮的特性共同导致了事故，不过他仍然承认自己需要为此担起责任。
错失了一个大好机会，尤其是超越队友的机会，而他的队友这个周末一再从逆境中反弹。——杰克·贝尼翁
在马德里赛道和阿塞拜疆巴库的二练中接连撞车之后，林德布拉德带着信心不足的状态进入这场比赛，尽管方式并不完美，但他在周日的正赛中领跑中游集团并斩获大把积分，将是一次很好的提振。
首先，是那个无法回避的问题：第39圈安全车重启时，他与小红牛车队的队友利亚姆·劳森发生了碰撞。
林德布拉德声称奥孔“基本上在刹车时变线”，所以他“不得不采取避让动作，这导致我的前轮轻微锁死，然后撞上了利亚姆”。
无论这些辩解理由是否属实（从回放画面来看，奥孔似乎并没有这样做），林德布拉德都逃脱了处罚，并在混乱中意外地从中获益。
他还批评了发车时的松散以及起跑编队组织不当的问题，导致车手们反复地加速又刹车。
detailEn: Team-mates colliding, the world champion calling for a driver to be banned, a win drought broken, a top team resurgent and a returnee on the podium - there was plenty going on in Formula 1's 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
Here's our take on who came out best and worst.

After a couple of encouraging signs at Monza - where Franco Colapinto was fast but made errors - and Madring - where Colapinto was quicker than Alpine team-mate Pierre Gasly and arguably executed his best weekend yet in F1 - he went and spoiled it all by doing something stupid.

A few drivers spoke out in his defence. Carlos Sainz addressed the tricky tyres, dirty circuit and weird power delivery of the engines in Baku, while Arvid Lindblad criticised the way the safety car restarts were handled.

But ultimately Colapinto was the only one to lock both front wheels and clatter into two cars at once. When one of those cars is your team-mate's you really are in trouble. He at least took "full responsibility" - not that there was much else he could do in the circumstances.
And because he couldn't serve the 10 second time penalty the stewards gave him, that will mean a grid penalty for Sepang. - Ben Anderson
From looking odds on for a double points finish to actually achieving a catastrophic double DNF in the space of one major Colapinto braking misjudgement.
This was ultimately a disastrous conclusion to the weekend for Alpine, after producing what Gasly called "the best race car we've had so far this year".

Colapinto wiping out both Gasly and the McLaren of Lando Norris not only robbed Alpine of at least the seven championship points they were holding before it all went wrong, it also created the conditions for Lindblad to bag the seventh place Gasly was holding and extend the gap Racing Bulls holds over Alpine to 15 points in their battle for fifth in the constructors' title race. - BA

April 21 2024. That's how far you have to go back for Red Bull's most recent double podium before Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar's 2-3 finish in Baku. It's frankly an absurd stat for a team that, despite its troubles, has so obviously remained among F1's top operators throughout that time.

This was as good a performance as we've seen from Hadjar since his graduation to the senior team - he acknowledged as much, saying it was the "first time with the team that I actually get to do a very clean weekend" - all the more impressive considering it came on his first weekend back from injury.

He was effective in battle, understood the assignment when Verstappen closed up to him, and played the team game like a pro. Even the radio messages felt like they were a little less terse than usual here.
If he was looking to show Red Bull what it had been missing while he was out, this was a damn good way to do it. - Jack Cozens
Turn 1 felt as if actively malicious to the McLarens this Saturday, with two offs and one crash that meant zero points on a weekend the team really should have outscored the power-limited Ferraris.

Norris seemed up against it (speed-limited by an issue but also clearly just in a bit of a funk) throughout the entirety of the weekend, so took the crash with the Alpines - shortly after he'd messed up his own race already by visiting the run-off at the same corner - as a final insult to cap off a miserable outing.
He was unsparing in his assessment of Colapinto's error, but also just unhappy about his race.

"I had no chance out there with the speed I had," he lamented. "Sure there were some things I wasn't doing well enough in driving and I need to see what I could improve next time, but at the same time, the speed that they came past me, that was impossible. So it was a pretty impossible task out there."
But team-mate Oscar Piastri was doing stellar work in the fight for a podium until it was undone by a strange lock-up of both fronts that sent him down the order.

"I didn't think I did anything spectacular [to cause it]," he mused. "Obviously I was on a different line to what I normally would be, defending, so I don't know if I was on a crown in the road or something, but it certainly was a surprise to me." - Val Khorounzhiy
George Russell's victory from pole position, which he described as "the most dominant weekend I've had in my career" validates the progress he's spoken repeatedly about making since the August break.

After all, while he was given a clear run by title rival Kimi Antonelli clipping the Turn 1 wall in qualifying, Russell was genuinely quick and looked to have a pace advantage over his Mercedes team-mate anyway.

"I'm very proud of the resilience that I and my close group of engineers have shown during the tough periods this year, because there's been a lot of hard work to overcome some of the challenges to adapt my driving style to suit this new car better," said Russell. "F1 is so tough you don't get opportunities to practice this.

"And finally, it's coming to me a bit more intuitively than it once did, and I'm gaining confidence. And especially on circuits like this, it just allows you to eke out that little bit more on the brakes, get that little bit closer to the walls, and it's been a flawless weekend." - Edd Straw

Fastest race lap is usually a rubbish metric to measure performance in an F1 race, but Valtteri Bottas's being 1.5s down on what Cadillac team-mate Sergio Perez managed does seem reflective of the race we saw.

Even before his crash at the end of the race - attributed to a harvesting glitch triggered by an earlier off at Turn 1, as "the systems got a bit confused" - the performance was properly, head-scratchingly miserable.

"A long one," Bottas admitted. "Just, honestly, no pace at all. I could only fight with Fernando [Alonso]. For sure, we lost some time there, but otherwise just pretty far off, so lots of things to look into from this weekend."

"Pretty far off" is an understatement - Bottas was nearly a minute down on Perez at the time of his first pitstop, so whatever was wrong was very wrong - and has to be a huge priority for himself and Cadillac to figure out. - VK

This was Verstappen and Red Bull's strongest weekend in terms of pace and the fact he finished just two tenths of a second behind winner Russell despite a power unit disadvantage is proof of the progress Red Bull is making.

While his victory chances might have been boosted had he started where he should have done on the front row, instead of eighth thanks to a power unit problem, Verstappen suspects that it would have been difficult to have done better than second anyway.
"Even if I started second, I think the pace of George would have been very hard to pass," said Verstappen.

But the fact Red Bull was a genuine victory contender in Azerbaijan (a rarity in 2026) and the tantalising possibility that starting where he should have done could have led to victory, is a much-needed boost for Verstappen. - ES
After Carlos Sainz was given a five-place penalty having initially qualified in ninth, Alex Albon was given the chance to avenge the defeat from his Williams team-mate, given he was dumped out in Q2.

He was keeping Esteban Ocon behind in 13th when he crashed at Turn 3, locking up and heading straight into the wall. Sainz recovered from dropping to 19th with an early stop to come back and score a point.

Albon said the incident was "odd". He reckoned a combination of a big wind gust, and the Williams car's characteristic of raising a wheel under heavy braking, could have caused the incident, although he still acknowledged his need to hold his hands up for it.
A big opportunity missed, especially to outperform his team-mate, who repeatedly bounced back from adversity this weekend. - Jack Benyon

After consecutive crashes in FP2s at the Madring and in Baku, Lindblad was struggling for confidence entering this race, and even though it wasn't the perfect way to do it, leading the midfield and bagging big points in Sunday's race will be a nice boost.
First, the elephant in the room, his contact with team-mate Racing Bulls Liam Lawson on the lap 39 safety car restart.
Lindblad claimed Ocon "basically moved under braking" so he "had to take avoiding action which meant I locked the front slightly and I hit Liam".
Whatever the accuracy of those mitigating circumstances (a review of the angles suggested Ocon wasn't doing so), Lindblad escaped unpunished and inadvertently benefitted from the chaos.
He also criticised the slackness of the start and how it was poorly formed up, causing drivers to accelerate then brake repeatedly.
keyPointsZh: 科拉平托在蒙扎和马德里赛道曾有令人鼓舞的表现，在马德里赛道比 阿尔派 队友加斯利更快，但最终毁了这一切。
塞恩斯为他辩护，指出巴库轮胎棘手、赛道脏且引擎动力输出怪异。
林布拉德则批评了安全车重启的处理方式。

Carlos Sainz defended him, citing the tricky tyres, dirty circuit and weird engine power delivery in Baku.
